# YuvexPay

> YuvexPay is a Brazilian payment gateway. The public REST API at `https://api.yuvexpay.com/v1/*` lets developers accept payments (PIX, credit card, boleto), issue refunds, move money out via PIX withdrawals, and manage products, customers, statements and webhooks.

All requests authenticate with a YuvexPay API key sent as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer ypk_<env>_<kid>_<secret>`. `<env>` is `test` (sandbox) or `live` (production). The same base URL serves both environments.

Write endpoints (`POST /v1/payments`, `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund`, `POST /v1/withdrawals`, `POST /v1/products`, `POST /v1/customers`) require an `X-Idempotency-Key` header.

All amounts are in **BRL** as decimal numbers (e.g. `49.90`), not cents.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/quickstart): Create your first payment with a PIX QR code in under 5 minutes.
- [Authentication](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/authentication): API key format (`ypk_<env>_<kid>_<secret>`), scopes, IP allowlist, rotation, and `GET /v1/auth/self` for self-introspection.
- [Idempotency](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/idempotency): The `X-Idempotency-Key` contract: 24h TTL, 100-char limit, scoped per company and environment, payload-mismatch detection.
- [Errors](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/errors): Standard error envelope and the full code list (auth, validation, idempotency, payment, refund and withdrawal codes).
- [Rate limiting](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/rate-limiting): Per-company limits, response headers (`X-RateLimit-*`), and exponential backoff guidance.
- [Environments](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/environments): Sandbox vs. production. Same URL, different key prefix.
- [Sandbox testing](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/sandbox): Deterministic recipes — payment cents `.01` is paid, `.02` stays unpaid, `.03` cancelled, `.04` expired, `.05` MED-frozen. Withdrawal cents `.01` completed, `.02`/`.03` failed, `.04` stays processing.
- [Payments guide](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/payments): Headless PIX, headless direct CARD, hosted multi-method checkout, and BOLETO. Lifecycle from `NEW` to `PAID`/`REFUNDED`.
- [Refunds](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/refunds): Eligibility rules, full-only refund support today, lifecycle, and error codes (`REFUND_IN_PROGRESS`, `REFUND_NOT_SUPPORTED`, etc.).
- [Withdrawals](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/withdrawals): PIX-only, BRL-only, daily/nightly limits, masked `pixKey`, and the never-retry rule on ambiguous `PROCESSING` (whose horizon is hours, not minutes). **`amount` is the NET the recipient receives; the flat fee is added on top, so the balance is debited `grossAmount = amount + feeAmount`.** Gross is what `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE`, the daily/nightly `used` counter and the per-transaction cap are measured against; the minimum is measured against the net and is `R$ 10.00` unless raised for the account — read `minAmount` from `GET /v1/withdrawals/limits`. The creditor document sent to the network resolves in three steps: `destination.recipientDocument` when sent, else the PIX key itself when it is a CPF or CNPJ key, else your own tax id. `creditorDocumentSource` is dashboard-only and returns `400 CREDITOR_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_NOT_SUPPORTED` on the public API. Per-transaction caps are account-dependent and come from `GET /v1/withdrawals/limits`, not a fixed platform maximum.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/guides/webhooks): `v1` HMAC-SHA256 signature with timestamp anti-replay (`X-Webhook-Signature`, `X-Webhook-Timestamp`), at-least-once delivery, no order guarantees, retries. **The HTTP body is the bare event object — there is no `{ id, type, data }` envelope and the event name is carried only in the `X-Webhook-Event` header.** Twelve subscribable event types. `PAYMENT_PAID` carries a `payer` block (name, CPF/CNPJ, institution name + ISPB) plus the network `endToEndId`; `payer.document` carries the provider's masked string (for example `***405566**`) when no full document is on file, and is `null` only when neither was captured. `WITHDRAWAL_SENT` carries a `recipient` block, populated when the withdrawal had a recipient document. Both blocks are `null` when every field would be null. Sandbox payments and withdrawals deliver no webhooks at all.

## API reference

- [API overview](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/introduction)
- [Inspect API key](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/auth/self): `GET /v1/auth/self`
- [Create payment](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/create): `POST /v1/payments` — PIX supports `enforcePayerDocument` (best-effort same-document opt-in).
- [List payments](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/list): `GET /v1/payments`
- [Get payment](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/get): `GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}` — paid PIX payments include a nullable `payer` block (name, document, institution name + ISPB) and `paidAt`.
- [Get payment by txId](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/get-by-txid): `GET /v1/payments/txid/{txId}`
- [Download boleto PDF](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/get-boleto): `GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}/boleto`
- [Refund payment](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/refund): `POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund`
- [List refunds](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/payments/list-refunds): `GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refunds`
- [Balance](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/balance/get): `GET /v1/balance`
- [Create withdrawal](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/withdrawals/create): `POST /v1/withdrawals` — optional `destination.recipientDocument` (CPF/CNPJ of the PIX key holder); send it for any third-party payout.
- [List withdrawals](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/withdrawals/list): `GET /v1/withdrawals`
- [Get withdrawal](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/withdrawals/get): `GET /v1/withdrawals/{withdrawalId}`
- [Withdrawal limits](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/withdrawals/limits): `GET /v1/withdrawals/limits` — daily/nightly window, `minAmount` and `perTransactionLimit`.
- [Create product](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/create): `POST /v1/products`
- [List products](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/list): `GET /v1/products`
- [Get product](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/get): `GET /v1/products/{productId}`
- [Get product by external id](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/get-by-external-id): `GET /v1/products/external/{externalId}`
- [Update product](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/update): `PATCH /v1/products/{productId}`
- [Delete product](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/delete): `DELETE /v1/products/{productId}`
- [Upload product image](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/upload-image): `POST /v1/products/{productId}/image`
- [Delete product image](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/products/delete-image): `DELETE /v1/products/{productId}/image`
- [Create customer](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/create): `POST /v1/customers`
- [List customers](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/list): `GET /v1/customers`
- [Get customer](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/get): `GET /v1/customers/{customerId}` — `customerId` is a `cus_*` slug, not a UUID.
- [Update customer](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/update): `PATCH /v1/customers/{customerId}`
- [Delete customer](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/customers/delete): `DELETE /v1/customers/{customerId}`
- [Payment receipt](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/documents/payment-receipt): `GET /v1/documents/payments/{paymentId}/receipt` — scoped to the key's environment; an id from the other environment returns `404`.
- [Withdrawal receipt](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/documents/withdrawal-receipt): `GET /v1/documents/withdrawals/{withdrawalId}/receipt` — same environment scoping.
- [Account statement](https://docs.yuvexpay.com/api-reference/documents/statement): `GET /v1/documents/statements` — built from the real-money ledger, so a sandbox key always gets an empty statement.
